Reported so that a result which depends on a single censoring decision is VISIBLE, not so that the decision can be reversed after seeing the outcome.

sensitivity_note: DEFINITION-SENSITIVE — a sensitivity flips significance: ['committed_16_included']. The PRIMARY still decides; promotion (if any) carries this caveat VISIBLY.
locked_state_finding: LOCKED-STATE SUSTAIN DOES NOT EXIST AT 500k IN THIS REGIME (recorded, prereg §6). mean(last 10) >= ruler returns 0/16 on the committed verdict seeds; no bar both controls alpha and produces sustainers (the alpha-calibrated K=10 bar is 0.79 > the ruler). Conversion is EPISODIC (2-27 recurring episodes per committed converter at the ruler, median 9), so a locked-state read measures a state the phenomenon does not occupy. Hence the re-posed continuous primary.
